ops.text: Behind the cellar? There's only the old arch Figgs bricked up the year we bought the place, and it still breathes cold on rainy nights.
Mind the third step down, and if you move my kegs you put them back where you found them.
Kenji went down to change the lager twenty minutes ago and I haven't heard the pump since.
Figgs & Potts has a keg cellar under its floor, reached by the hatch near the front plants; at its back is an old arch that Figgs bricked up when he and Potts took over the bar.
Kenji, the bar's young cellarman, went down to change a keg and has not come back up.

ops.why: the cellar hatch cover already at 5,13 lifts onto steps down to the keg cellar

ops.title: Figgs & Potts Cellar
ops.purpose: The bar's keg cellar, where the player can see what lies behind it: the arch Figgs bricked up, and Kenji, who went down to change a keg.
ops.sketch: A low brick cellar under the bar, lit by one hanging lantern. The ladder/steps up sit at the south-west, in the same column as the hatch at 5,13 above. Kegs and crates line the east and west walls, and beer-line pipes run along the top wall to the taps above. In the middle of the north wall is the old arch, bricked up badly: some bricks have fallen into rubble, and a cold draught and the sound of running water come through the gap, because the storm drain lies beyond. Kenji, the young cellarman, crouches by the arch with a torch instead of changing the lager. The room is closed on every side; the arch is a latent closure that could open later toward the storm drain.
must: a ladder or steps up in column x=5, under the bar's hatch at 5,13, linked back to bar_start
stacked kegs (barrel_old) and crates along the side walls, with a keg pump and pipes running to the taps above
the bricked-up arch in the north wall, with fallen bricks (rubble) and a puddle where the draught and drip come through; still closed
Kenji, the young cellarman, by the arch with a torch, saying: "Listen, there's water running behind these bricks, and it isn't ours."
one hanging lantern; the far corners are dark
a ladder_up at exactly (8,2) linking back: `link vert (8,2) -> bar_start (10,7)`
